_comment: A2.2 vocabulary, hand-written against data/blueprints-a2.json. Same job as vocab-a2-1.json: the generated deck filled these units from a frequency-ordered subtitle pool, so 'Geld und Konten' taught Diagnose and Operation. Words that A1 or A2.1 already teach are deliberately absent — the nearest neighbours are Probleme lösen (A2.1 u19) and Wohnung suchen (A2.1 u11), so Beschwerden and Umzug here pick up where those stop.
